examples: Experimental workflow diagram, left-to-right horizontal flow with 5 numbered steps: (1) Cell culture seeding 1x10^6 cells/mL in 6-well plate, (2) Serum starvation 24h, (3) Drug treatment with 10uM compound for 48h, (4) RNA extraction with TRIzol, (5) qRT-PCR analysis. Rounded rectangle nodes with step numbers in circles, method names in bold Arial, parameters in italic. Arrows dark gray #374151. White background. 4K, publication-ready clean flowchart.

Western blot experimental protocol flowchart, vertical top-to-bottom layout: protein extraction → BCA quantification → SDS-PAGE electrophoresis (30ug load) → transfer to PVDF → blocking 5% BSA 1h → primary antibody overnight 4C → HRP-conjugated secondary 1h → ECL detection. Each step in rounded rectangle with parameter annotations on arrows. Grayscale with blue accent #2563eb. 4K, journal methods figure style.

CRISPR-Cas9 gene knockout workflow infographic, 6 steps with icons: gRNA design → plasmid construction → lentivirus packaging → transduction → puromycin selection → validation by sequencing. Icon-based steps, numbered badges, connecting dotted line. Bilingual labels 敲除验证 (Knockout Validation). Vibrant educational palette. 4K.
accuracy_tips: 步骤必须按时间顺序编号；关键参数（浓度/时间/温度）标在箭头或节点旁；不虚构实验数据或结果；样本量 n 值注明；统计方法在最后一步标注；对照 组（control）必须显示；方向明确（left-to-right 或 top-to-bottom）。
